Review Instagram?

Reviewers largely see Instagram as a strong visual platform for sharing photos, videos, Stories, and especially Reels, with broad reach for creators, brands, and small businesses. Many use it daily to build community, showcase work, follow trends, and run marketing or shopping campaigns. The main complaints are familiar: unpredictable algorithm changes, weaker organic reach, too many ads and creator promotions, privacy and mental health concerns, and poor support or account recovery. Makers of AdAnt AI and Subgrapher also rely on Reels for research and audience reach.
